## Validation Summary
7 files created (JavaScript, JSON, YAML), 4 of 4 tasks completed — pipeline passed all stages with 2 issues caught and resolved during review gate.

## Issues Detected

- **Missing payload type guard on POST /todos** — non-object/array request bodies were accepted without rejection; caught at CODE_REVIEW stage. Root cause: INCOMPLETE_IMPLEMENTATION. Fix applied: type validation added before field processing.
- **Missing payload type guard on PATCH /todos/:id** — same class of malformed-input acceptance before update field processing; caught at CODE_REVIEW stage. Root cause: INCOMPLETE_IMPLEMENTATION. Fix applied: type validation added at handler entry point.

## Checks Passed
COMPILATION, CODE_REVIEW, endpoint coverage (5/5 required), status code correctness, UUID usage, in-memory storage wiring, PORT env var support, newest-first sort via unshift, unknown field rejection on PATCH, README with install/run instructions, schema accuracy (HIGH), non-functional coverage (COMPLETE)

## Bottom Line
2 issues were caught and resolved by automated checks before merge.
